questions.prompt: apply_edit is registered through coder.ctx and search_code on the root. What does tools.list(reviewer) return?
options: Both tools, because they share one tools service
No tools, because the reviewer registered none
Only search_code, because apply_edit carries the coder's tag
Only apply_edit, because it was registered last
questions.explanation: Untagged tools are in the shared table that every agent sees. apply_edit is in the coder's table, so the reviewer never sees it.

questions.prompt: A logger on the root and a counter on coder.ctx listen to tool/finished. Each agent finishes one call. How many times does each run?
questions.explanation: An untagged listener runs for every agent, so the logger runs twice. The counter's tag is coder, so it runs only for the coder's call.

questions.prompt: Why is a scope made as a plugin with its own fiber?
options: So the agent can read the root's services
So the agent's tools run in parallel
So the agent can change its tag later
So disposing the scope removes every tool and listener registered through it
questions.explanation: Registrations through the scope's context are effects on its fiber. Disposing that fiber undoes them, and other agents are not affected.
